```javascript
// Sample array of objects with a 'count' field
const items = [
  { name: 'Item A', count: 18 },
  { name: 'Item B', count: 11 },
  { name: 'Item C', count: 24 }
];

console.log('Before sorting:');
console.log(items);

// Sort the array by the 'count' field (ascending order)
const sortedItems = items.sort((a, b) => a.count - b.count);

console.log('\nAfter sorting:');
console.log(sortedItems);
```

```
]

  { name: 'Item A', count: 18 },
  { name: 'Item C', count: 24 }
]
```

  ```javascript

  ```

- To sort in descending order, reverse the subtraction:
  
  ```javascript
  const sortedItems = items.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
  ```
